correctness.rationale: The exact seven-class, six-irrep decomposition was constructed by standard, two-subset, exterior-square and sign twists with character orthogonality. The sign multiplier is strictly increasing for all nonnegative exponents by exact logarithm-series inequalities, has F(0)=-1 and F(8/25)>0 by rational root certificates, and all other multipliers remain strictly negative up to its unique zero. Schur-Fourier conditional negativity, centered Gram rank and Schoenberg Gaussian strictness then prove all claimed quantifiers and boundaries; check.py independently reproduces critical arithmetic.

value.rationale: A complete classification of the canonical 120-point symmetric-group transposition metric computes a motivated natural negative-type invariant, identifies its non-obvious sign-representation obstruction and unique transcendental threshold, and determines exact endpoint loss of squared-Euclidean embedding dimension. It gives the all-bandwidth covariance admissibility criterion for the same natural homogeneous metric. The scope is a full finite natural object rather than an arbitrary selected coefficient or numerical slice.
